title: Add memory write validation, activation, stale, supersede, archive, and reject APIs
verify: Memory write activation requires valid AgentProfile, AgentHarnessRun, allowed source/evidence refs, compatible claim type, trust/freshness labels, redaction status, and trace ref.
Stale, supersede, archive, and reject transitions retain audit/source refs and block ordinary retrieval.
API responses expose bounded refs/status only, not raw memory blobs, hidden reasoning, or secrets.
evidence_required: VERDICT: PASS, SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present
constraints: Unknown properties are rejected for command/mutation payloads.
Memory that touches Plant confirmation, Safety Gate, physical actions, governance, or dataset trainability remains non-authoritative.
Redaction runs before persistence or publication.
invariants: Every state-changing transition is actor-attributed where a human/API action is involved.
Agent memory is retained under lifecycle state but excluded from retrieval when stale/superseded/archived/rejected.
